title: Contains Duplicate
description: Given an integer array nums, return true if any value appears at least twice in the array, and return false if every element is distinct.
hints: A hash set gives you O(1) membership checks.
As you scan, if an element is already in the set, you've found a duplicate.
solution_approach: Insert each element into a hash set. If the element is already present before inserting, return true. After the loop, return false. An alternative is to sort and check adjacent equals.
time_complexity: O(N) with a set, or O(N log N) with sorting
space_complexity: O(N) for the set, O(1) for sorting
common_mistakes: Counting frequencies when a simple existence check is enough.
Forgetting to return after the first duplicate is found.
